basic_details.job_title: DW&CWO Palnadu Case Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Women Child Welfare & Empowerment Office Palnadu (DW&CWO Palnadu) has announced 1 vacancy for the Case Worker post on a contract basis, requiring applicants to submit the filled application form by hand to the DW & CW & EO, Palnadu District before 5:00 PM on 20 October 2026. The positions are purely on contract basis and the staff should be coterminous with the scheme. Only Female Local Candidates are eligible to apply, with an age limit of 25 to 44 years. The required qualification is a Bachelor in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Social science/Psychology with at least 3 years experience,

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Any woman having a Bachelor in Law/Social Work/Sociology/Social science/Psychology with at least 3 years experience of working on women related relevant domains in a Government or Non-Government project/programme. Residency Requirement: She should preferably be a resident of the local community to utilize local human resources and expertise for effective functioning of the Centre. Only female local candidates are eligible. Age Limit: 25 to 44 years.

selection_process: The selection process comprises the shortlisting of qualified candidates followed by an interview. Only qualified shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Case Worker post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form by hand is 20 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Bachelor's degree in Law, Social Work, Sociology, Social Science, or Psychology, along with at least 3 years of experience working on women-related relevant domains in a Government or Non-Government project or programme.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between 25 and 44 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 19,500/-.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must download the application form and submit it by hand along with attested copies of required certificates to the DW & CW & EO, Palnadu District.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting qualified candidates, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is purely on a contract basis, and the staff will be coterminous with the scheme.

faq.question: Q9. Who is eligible to apply for this position?
faq.answer: Only female local candidates who meet the educational, experience, and age criteria are eligible to apply.
